meta.note: Current cells are populated only from Farmington-specific retailer pages or other verified observations. Historical receipt prices remain in history and are not silently promoted to current.
meta.receipt_catalog_note: User receipts expand the master catalog and historical price record. Receipt prices are not treated as current offers unless freshness and package/unit details are known.
meta.catalog_note: Receipt-derived catalog includes every legible food line from the supplied Sam's receipts; unclear receipt abbreviations are retained verbatim instead of guessed.
meta.target_inventory: Core Farmington household grocery inventory; daily collectors populate only verified local observations.

automation.policy: Public weekly-ad deals via Flipp; Smith's full catalog via official Kroger API when credentials are configured. Preserve prior verified values when a source fails.
